pairs: In diebus illis ægrotavit Ezechias usque ad mortem:
In those days, Hezekiah was sick unto death.
et venit ad eum Isaias filius Amos propheta,
And the prophet Isaiah, the son of Amoz,
Qui convertit faciem suam ad parietem,
And he turned his face to the wall,
and he prayed to the Lord,
quomodo ambulaverim coram te in veritate,
remember how I have walked before you in truth,
et quod placitum est coram te fecerim.
and how I have done what is pleasing before you.”
And then Hezekiah wept with a great weeping.
Et antequam egrederetur Isaias mediam partem atrii,
And before Isaiah departed from the middle part of the atrium,
factus est sermo Domini ad eum,
the word of the Lord came to him,
et dic Ezechiæ duci populi mei:
the leader of my people: Thus says the Lord,
Hæc dicit Dominus Deus David patris tui:
the God of your father David: I have heard your prayer,
and I have seen your tears.
And behold, I have healed you.
you shall ascend to the temple of the Lord.
Et addam diebus tuis quindecim annos:
And I will add fifteen years to your days.
sed et de manu regis Assyriorum liberabo te,
I will free you and this city from the hand of the king of the Assyrians.
et protegam urbem istam propter me,
And I will protect this city for my own sake,
and for the sake of my servant David.”
And when they had brought it,
and they had placed it on his sore,
But Hezekiah had said to Isaiah,
Quod erit signum, quia Dominus me sanabit,
“What will be the sign that the Lord will heal me,
et quia ascensurus sum die tertia templum Domini?
and that I will ascend to the temple of the Lord on the third day?”
Hoc erit signum a Domino quod facturus sit Dominus sermonem quem locutus est:
“This will be the sign from the Lord, that the Lord will do the word that he has spoken:
vis ut ascendat umbra decem lineis,
Do you wish that the shadow may ascend ten lines,
or that it may turn back for the same number of degrees?”
Facile est umbram crescere decem lineis:
“It is easy for the shadow to increase for ten lines.
And so I do not wish that this be done.
sed ut revertatur retrorsum decem gradibus.
Instead, let it turn back for ten degrees.”
And so the prophet Isaiah called upon the Lord.
et reduxit umbram per lineas quibus jam descenderat in horologio Achaz,
And he led back the shadow, along the lines by which it had already descended on the sundial of Ahaz,
In tempore illo misit Berodach Baladan,
sent letters and gifts to Hezekiah.
For he had heard that Hezekiah had been ill.
Lætatus est autem in adventu eorum Ezechias,
Now Hezekiah rejoiced at their arrival,
and so he revealed to them the house of aromatic spices,
and the various pigments and ointments,
and the house of his vessels,
and all that he was able to have in his treasuries.
et omnia quæ habere poterat in thesauris suis.
There was nothing in his house,
Non fuit quod non monstraret eis Ezechias in domo sua,
that Hezekiah did not show to them.
Venit autem Isaias propheta ad regem Ezechiam,
Then the prophet Isaiah came to king Hezekiah,
And from where did they come to you?”
De terra longinqua venerunt ad me,
“What did they see in your house?”
Omnia quæcumque sunt in domo mea, viderunt:
“They saw all things whatsoever that are in my house.
nihil est quod non monstraverim eis in thesauris meis.
There is nothing in my treasuries that I did not show to them.”
And so Isaiah said to Hezekiah:
“Listen to the word of the Lord.
et auferentur omnia quæ sunt in domo tua,
the days are coming when all that is in your house,
et quæ condiderunt patres tui usque in diem hanc,
and all that your fathers have stored up even to this day,
will be carried away to Babylon.
et de filiis tuis qui egredientur ex te,
they will take from your sons,
who will go forth from you,
et erunt eunuchi in palatio regis Babylonis.
And they will be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.”
Bonus sermo Domini quem locutus es:
“The word of the Lord, which you have spoken,
sit pax et veritas in diebus meis.
is good. Let peace and truth be in my days.”
Now the rest of the words of Hezekiah,
and how he made a pool,
and how he brought waters into the city,
nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Juda?
have these not been written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Judah?
And Hezekiah slept with his fathers.
et regnavit Manasses filius ejus pro eo.
And Manasseh, his son, reigned in his place.
